name: s3Delete
syntax: s3Delete(bucket [, object, force, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Deletes an S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket or a single object. Without an object argument the bucket itself is deleted; with an object argument the single key is deleted. Deleting a non-empty bucket requires force=true, which empties the bucket first.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket to delete, or the bucket containing the object.

params.name: object
params.description: The object key to delete. When omitted, the bucket itself is deleted.

params.name: force
params.description: When deleting a bucket, true empties the bucket first. Defaults to false.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Delete a single object
examples.description: Removes one key from the bucket.

examples.title: Delete a bucket and its contents
examples.description: force=true empties the bucket before deleting it.
